newsitem.title: UK: UK eases restrictions on pools, bingo, casinos.
newsitem.headline: UK eases restrictions on pools, bingo, casinos.

text.p: New laws easing restrictions on casinos, bingo clubs and soccer pools operators will come into effect next month, Britain's Home Office said on Monday.

The laws will allow pools operators to collect stakes for midweek competitions in pubs, shops and other premises. This will bring the regulations in line with those in force at weekends and facilitate a midweek competition.
Another provision enables casinos and bingo clubs to accept payments on debit cards in addition to by cheque.
A third sweeps away all restrictions on bingo advertising, including commercials on radio and television.
Britain's gaming companies have lobbied for an easing of restrictions following stiff competition from the UK National Lottery, launched in November 1994.
Pools companies Littlewoods and Vernons, owned by Ladbroke Group Plc, have announced job cuts in recent weeks as competition from the second weekly lottery draw bites.
